displayBoard.name: DLP#00_concept
displayBoard.subtitle:
I call myself as a Digitalian, because I spend most of my daytime in digital world. My artwork captures my gaze in the digital world I live in as a landscape painting.

Artwork 'DLP #00 concept' is a concept image of the DLP collection. DLP will show 12 artworks. The selling price of all artworks is 121% of the selling price of the previous works.
